title: 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor Pricing, Specs, and Release Date
summary: Essentially an off-the-showroom-floor Baja vehicle, the 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor gets minor updates but carries over its potent engine and incredibly capable chassis.
body_markdown:
The Ford Bronco Raptor was added to the Bronco lineup in 2022, and while it has received some package features and appearance options, there haven't been any major changes in the last four years. The Bronco Raptor is a midsize body-on-frame SUV that competes in a very niche segment of high-performance, desert-running SUVs. Primary competitors include the Jeep Wrangler Rubicon 392 and the Land Rover Defender Octa. The 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor is a standalone trim at the top end of the Bronco lineup.

## What’s New for the 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor


There have been no mechanical changes to the Ford Bronco Raptor since its introduction in 2022, and the updates it has received over the last few years have been minor. New for 2026, the Bronco Raptor gets a standard digital rear-view mirror, a leather gearshift knob, a new Avalanche Gray paint, and some additional accessories and option packages.


## Design


The standard Ford Bronco has a very upright stance and rugged appearance, while the Raptor adds wider fender flares, a vented hood, a standard modular steel front bumper, and beefier 37-inch all-terrain tires on 17-inch wheels. It also has a trio of federally mandated amber marker lights because the body width exceeds 80 inches. Even though the Raptor model looks drastically different than the other Bronco models, it still offers a number of appearance packages, including the Black Appearance Package, the Shadow Black Appearance Package, and the Code Orange Appearance Package. There are also some Raptor graphics available with various packages.


## Powertrain


The 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor has a single powertrain option: a turbocharged 3.0-liter V6 engine that delivers 418 horsepower and 440 pound-feet of torque. It has standard four-wheel drive (4WD), is only available with a 10-speed automatic transmission, and has a maximum tow rating of 4,500 pounds. The EPA-estimated fuel economy is 15 mpg in the city and 16 mpg on the highway.


## Interior


For such a rugged vehicle, the 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor has a surprisingly premium and advanced interior. It has large digital displays, heated front-row seats, a heated steering wheel, and rubberized flooring with drain plugs. Standard seating surfaces are black vinyl, and leather-and-vinyl trimmed seats are available. While the Bronco Raptor seats five passengers and has 35.6 cubic feet of cargo space behind the second row, just like the regular Bronco, it has less overall cargo space, at 72.9 cubic feet behind the first row. There is no moonroof because the hard-top roof on the Bronco Raptor is removable.


## Technology


The 2026 Bronco Raptor has two 12-inch digital displays—one for the gauge cluster and one for the infotainment screen. The Bronco Raptor is also packed with standard tech features, such as wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, a surround-view camera system with off-road views, low-speed off-road cruise control, Trail Turn Assist, Trail One-Pedal Drive, seven GOAT (Goes Over All Terrain) drive modes, and a premium 12-speaker Bang & Olufsen sound system. A Wi-Fi hotspot is available as part of the Ford Connectivity Package, and comes with a one-year free trial.

## Safety


As a top-tier trim, the Bronco Raptor comes with all the standard safety features Ford has to offer, including automatic emergency braking, blind-spot monitors, rear cross-traffic alert, lane-keep assist, high-beam assist, a surround-view camera system, front and rear parking sensors, adaptive cruise control, evasive-steer assist, and post-collision braking. The Insurance Institute for Highway Safety (IIHS) has not specifically crash-tested the Bronco Raptor, but it did test the 2026 Bronco, giving it two Good and one Marginal crash-test scores. It only received Marginal and Acceptable scores for crash avoidance and mitigation. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) has not crash-tested the 2026 Ford Bronco or the Bronco Raptor.


## Pricing and Release Date


The 2026 Ford Bronco Raptor went on sale in October of 2025. At the time of writing, Ford listed the base price for the Bronco Raptor at $82,685, and there are a number of pricey options available. Appearance packages range from $6,175 to $8,945, and the upmarket interior trim costs $2,495. Most paint colors are available for an additional $495 to $995, while a painted hard-top is a $1,250 to $1,450 option.
